verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community comment listing 'code owners' and 'protected branches' among the features of GitHub's paid private-repo plans. That confirms the code-owners feature exists, but nothing documents that approval from code owners can be required for changes to their paths. missing for 10: first-party documentation of CODEOWNERS path-ownership configuration, documented 'require review from code owners' enforcement via branch protection/rulesets, confirmation of availability on public open-source repos, hands-on corroboration
